messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: hotpath-us-west-2 GPU pool saturation detected. queue_depth=12k, avg_latency=1200ms, 5xx_rate=0.2%, 429_rate=18%. Triggered at 2024-11-15T04:12:01Z
Maria (oncall): acked. grabbing it now. paging SREs and eng-runtime.
Maria (oncall): @Kevin are you able to join for autoscale/lock checks?
Kevin (sre): on it. looking at autoscaler logs — seeing repeated failures to allocate nodes: 
```
E 04:12:07 autoscaler: ScaleUp failed: quota_exceeded for project:redwood-prod, reason: rate_limit_tokenbucket_rejected
E 04:12:07 autoscaler: DesiredNodes=10 CurrentNodes=4 MaxAllowed=6
```
Kevin (sre): interesting — tokenbucket rejections during scale attempts. looks like the token service is hitting per-tenant burst caps.
Zoe (eng-runtime): if the autoscaler can't open a request because of tokenbucket, it will never reach desired replicas and queues will back up. we had a similar pattern in staging last year.
Amit (support): getting multiple customer reports of timeouts on generate calls, key: acct-3312, acct-legacy-22. one reported 429s then fallback errors. escalating to CS.
Jules (infra): I can manually add nodes if we need immediate capacity. but want to understand root cause before changing quotas.
Maria (oncall): quick impact summary for customer comms: at least 3 large customers experiencing elevated latencies/429s in us-west. severity: P1 if sustained.
Kevin (sre): digging into tokenbucket service logs. snippet: 
```
W 04:11:58 tokenbucket: tenant=redwood-prod tier=hotpath burst_tokens=120 refill_rate=5/s granted=0 req=20
W 04:11:58 tokenbucket: rejecting request, token deficit=20
```
Kevin (sre): it seems a recent rollout reduced burst_tokens for the hotpath tier from 500->120 to reduce noisy neighbor risk. that change looks like it landed in the last config push.
Zoe (eng-runtime): that matches. rollout-8823 changed tier caps. we scoped it to non-prod but somehow prod flag was flipped.
Maria (oncall): okay immediate mitigations?
Zoe (eng-runtime): 1) Temporarily bump burst_tokens for tier=hotpath back to 800 (fast). 2) Allow autoscaler control-plane requests to bypass tokenbucket for 2 minutes (emergency). 3) Manually scale hotpath pool to +4 nodes.
Kevin (sre): agree. mitigation order: bump tokenbucket, then retry autoscale, then manual add if retry fails.
Jules (infra): running manual scale command now: 
```
# infractl
infractl pool scale --pool hotpath-us-west-2 --replicas 9 --reason "incident: tokenbucket starvation"
```
Jules (infra): submitted, nodes provisioning — ETA ~3m.
Maria (oncall): Zoe can you push an emergency config for tokenbucket? include a quickguard to revert after 30m.
Zoe (eng-runtime): pushing now. patch: 
```
PATCH /config/tokenbuckets/hotpath
{ "burst_tokens": 800, "emergency_ttl": "00:30:00" }
```
Zoe (eng-runtime): applied and propagated to control-plane caches at 04:16:22Z.
DevOps-rotation-bot: @Maria (oncall) flagged for escalation: incident severity upgraded to P1 due to multi-tenant impact.
Kevin (sre): re-triggering autoscaler reconciliation. logs: 
```
I 04:16:30 autoscaler: ScaleUpAttempt tenant=redwood-prod desired=10 current=4
I 04:16:31 autoscaler: tokenbucket granted=40 req=30 -> proceeding
I 04:16:31 autoscaler: provisioning 6 nodes
```
Kevin (sre): autoscaler now able to request. provisioning in-flight.
Amit (support): customers are seeing improvements in 429s but some still reporting latencies. I'm sending an interim note: "We're mitigating a capacity issue in us-west; expected resolution in ~10-20min. Engineers are on it."
Maria (oncall): good. keep CS updated, capture affected org ids for postmortem.
Jules (infra): new nodes joined hotpath pool at 04:20:45Z. pool size=9.
Kevin (sre): queue depth trending down: 12k -> 3.2k -> 0.6k over 10m. 429_rate dropping to 1.2%.
Zoe (eng-runtime): rolling back emergency bypass now that autoscaler can function. also starting a diagnostic job to validate token consumption across tiers.
Maria (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 10m. @Kevin please take ownership for primary mitigation and postmortem.
Kevin (sre): taking it. I'll own the follow-ups: revert buggy rollout flags, add canary gating to tier changes, and update runbook to ensure tokenbucket changes are tested in prod-candidate first.
Amit (support): capturing impacted customer ids: acct-3312, acct-998, acct-legacy-22. will open support tickets and add to incident doc.
Zoe (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause hypothesis: config rollout accidentally toggled prod tokenbucket caps for hotpath tier, reducing burst capacity below autoscaler needs during spikes. combination of burst cap drop + conservative max_nodes config caused autoscaler to stall.
Kevin (sre): follow-up action items: 
- rollback rollout-8823 flag fully (owner @Zoe).
- add autoscaler request path exemption from tokenbucket for control-plane actions (design approval needed).
- run a synthetic spike test on staging with patched tokenbucket semantics.
- postmortem doc + timeline (owner: Kevin).
Maria (oncall): thanks team. closing on-call handover to Kevin. I'll leave incident channel open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident status changed -> mitigated. severity=P1 -> monitoring. created incident ticket INC-21034.
Kevin (sre): I'll write the first draft of timeline and share in #incidents/postmortems. expecting full write-up by EOD.
Amit (support): leaving notes for CS to contact the three affected customers and offer credit.
Zoe (eng-runtime): will add unit/integration tests for tokenbucket gating to CI. planning a follow-up PR to make burst changes opt-in with manual gate.
Jules (infra): monitoring for any re-surge. infra metrics look stable.
Kevin (sre): last check: 429_rate=0.3%, queue_depth=120, all hotpath nodes healthy. marking handoff complete at 04:35:78Z.
Maria (oncall): thanks everyone.
